passage:
Mr. Fan repairs clocks. His shop is small and quiet, filled with ticking sounds. Many clocks on the wall show different times because they are waiting to be fixed.
A boy once asked him, "Why repair old clocks Phones can tell time."
Mr. Fan picked up a wooden clock and said, "This clock belonged to someone's grandmother. It does not only tell time. It tells a family story."
The boy looked around the shop again. He noticed names written on small paper tags. Each clock had an owner, and each owner had a reason to bring it there.
Phones may tell the correct time, but they do not always remind people of the past. That is why Mr. Fan's shop still opens every morning.
